svg.title: W4 Guest QEMU E2E Validation Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for W4 guest QEMU validation modules.
svg.text: 4-node / 8-node QEMU guests drive resource-backed UB UAPI descriptors into ChipBackend, cross simpler-capi into simpler, then return through ChipBackend and QEMU flush_cq.
Validation gates: sim-uapi ingress routes QEMU descriptors; ChipBackend -> simpler-capi -> simpler -> ChipBackend; sim-uapi egress feeds QEMU flush_cq -> guest CQ.
